note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes the metatag module's computed meta tags on entities as a MetaTagUnion (+ MetaTagInterface). It auto-adds the metatag base field to enabled entity types via hooks rather than a distinctive config key, so medium/hard cases are grounded in the real, restorable schema-provider registration on the server (schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers.graphql_compose_metatags; baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_metatags expose, and as what GraphQL type are an entity's computed meta tags returned?
evals.expected_output: It exposes the Metatag module's computed meta tags on entities as a MetaTagUnion (with a MetaTagInterface), resolving each tag to MetaTagValue/MetaTagLink/MetaTagProperty/MetaTagScript so a client can render the correct <head> tags.

evals.prompt: How does graphql_compose_metatags make the metatag field appear on an entity type in the schema (rather than requiring you to enable it as a normal field)?
evals.expected_output: It uses hook_graphql_compose_entity_base_fields_alter() to enable the entity's computed metatag base field on types that have one, and hook_graphql_compose_entity_interfaces_alter() to add MetaTagInterface; the metatag field is hidden from the field UI because it is a base field.

evals.prompt: Which hook in graphql_compose_metatags lets you resolve a custom metatag shape within the MetaTagUnion?
evals.expected_output: hook_graphql_compose_metatags_union_alter($value, ?string &$type) - set $type to your custom GraphQL type for matching tags.

evals.prompt: Inspect the GraphQL Compose server configuration (graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server) and state whether graphql_compose_metatags is currently registered in the schema providers list.

Register graphql_compose_metatags as a GraphQL Compose schema provider on the default server by adding it to schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers on graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
